prompt: In the town where the most successful American Ace of World War 2 to survive that war was born, there is a college. What was the name and percentage of the largest demographic of full and part time students attending that college in 2020?
answer:
The town is **Superior, Wisconsin**, birthplace of World War II ace **Major Richard Bong**. The college is the **University of Wisconsin–Superior**.  

In **2020**, the largest demographic among its full- and part-time students was **White students, at approximately 75%** of enrollment.
